semiconductor_relevance: High — ECM Greentech specializes in manufacturing equipment and processes for semiconductor fabrication, particularly in wafer processing and gas components.
summary: ECM Greentech provides engineering and manufacturing solutions for mass-production and laboratory furnaces used in semiconductor processing. Their expertise includes diffusion, oxidation, and wafer transport automation, along with innovative components for wafer handling.
capabilities: Mass-production and laboratory furnaces for atmospheric and reduced-pressure processing
Electrostatic chucks for thin and ultra-thin wafer processing
Gas components including valves and vaporization systems for various deposition processes
